title: core: `mergeAuthoredPresentation` and `axisPresentation` are published exports with no production caller once a dashboard widget stops reading `chartConfig.series` / `xAxis` / `yAxis` (objectui#11315)
body:
Filing-gate category: ③ a direct-dispatch task, retiring a published capability with zero consumers. Reader: triage first (grade and route). Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`) from objectui#11315's dev report (`5928600236`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`), judged fileable by PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11371's contract review (§③). ⛔ Not graded here.

Dedup: among the 610 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (read through REST on 2026-10-01 and grepped locally), `mergeAuthoredPresentation` and `axisPresentation` match only objectui#11315 and its PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11371.

## Measured (`git grep`, PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11371's head `25e43c3259`)

- `@object-ui/core` `packages/core/src/utils/chart-presentation.ts` exports `mergeAuthoredPresentation` and `axisPresentation`.
- Production callers after PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11371: **zero**. Its one caller was plugin-dashboard's `DatasetWidget`, which stops calling it because the spec retired `chartConfig.type` / `xAxis` / `yAxis` / `series` on a dashboard widget in 17.5.0. The react `ObjectChart` never called it: it hands its own `series` / `xAxis` / `yAxis` to `ChartRenderer` / `normalizeChartSchema`.
- Reached only by tests:
  - `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/chart-presentation.axisTitleI18n-10132.test.ts`;
  - `chart-presentation.i18nLabel-9038.test.ts`;
  - plugin-charts `ChartRenderer.axisTitleLocale-10132.test.tsx`.
- The pending changeset `.changeset/10132-dashboard-i18n-declared-not-resolved.md`, as corrected by PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11371, names the two functions as the carrier of its point 2 (axis titles resolving `I18nLabel`).

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- Per the startup-stage rule (a published capability with zero consumers is not kept for sunk cost): retire both exports.
- **Order matters.** First re-home point 2's pin onto a surface that still authors its own axes: an `ObjectChart` node's `xAxis` / `yAxis` through `normalizeChartSchema`, or wherever `axisTitleLocale-10132` really runs. Then delete the functions and their test files' cases. Then correct the 10132 changeset's carrier sentence in the same PR (it is pending, so it publishes verbatim).
- `@object-ui/core` takes a `minor` changeset with the break spelled out (two exports removed). This repository's fixed group declares its own breaks as `minor`.

Dedupe words: `mergeAuthoredPresentation dead export` · `axisPresentation no caller` · `chart-presentation retire merge`
